record.title: Trace stock two-word composition and the first downstream value use
record.intent: Establish the consumer dataflow before choosing a coherent device identity fixture.
requirements: Read-only analysis of the unchanged stock native library and existing guest evidence.
No new guest run, register response, physical instrument access or artifact modification.
Separate directly decoded operations, observed frames and unresolved indirect consumers.
acceptance: Pin disassembly and symbols for the two-word assembly and observed caller chain.
Identify the earliest established downstream store, transformation or value-dependent decision with exact offsets.
Explicitly bound unresolved calls and avoid assigning physical identity semantics from names alone.
Review the evidence with a bounded independent agent when available and resolve material findings.
